source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Seattle will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Bay Area Smash Room.

Seattle needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SMASH ROOM brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Seattle should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Seattle Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

The page should be designed so that once Seattle opens, we only need to turn on booking and update photos without redesigning the page.

The Seattle page should become the template for future locations.

routing_warnings.description: The client reports that the Seattle mockup uses the wrong company identity or logo; this concerns shared visual branding rather than the location page's section structure.
The requested corrections concern the subjects depicted in activity images, which are independently represented by the activity-specific imagery Requirement.
The missing packages concern the shared service catalog rather than the static location-page section structure.
This message specifies the content and role of the SmashRoomUSA master homepage, not the location-page content structure.
The observed problem is that Seattle and master-site profiles were assigned to the wrong sites, not that the required location-page sections were missing or incorrect.
